title: feat(plugin-auth): export answerOneTimeTokenHandoff so a host that forwards the auth routes answers the mobile sign-in hand-off
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XBK9EgGPfyQH8cn35jeTJe3)_

domain:server#6 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5kNHZKmo4BTWcwTdNs

Fixes #31420

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`@objectstack/plugin-auth` 包根新导出一个函数 `answerOneTimeTokenHandoff(manager, request, serving)` 和三个类型(`OneTimeTokenHandoffManager`、`OneTimeTokenHandoffServing`、`HandoffAnswer`)。它就是手机登录交接路由 `GET /api/v1/auth/one-time-token/handoff` 的整段处理逻辑;AuthPlugin 自己的路由改为调用它,所以只有一份实现。
- 为什么改:cloud 托管环境的内核没有自己的 HTTP 服务器,`/api/v1/auth/*` 由宿主转发给环境内核的 AuthManager,这条交接路由在托管环境上一直是 404,托管环境上的用户无法用 Google 登录手机 App。宿主无法自己补:令牌必须在交接模块的 challenge 作用域内生成,作用域外生成的令牌按设计无法兑换。现在宿主调用这个导出即可,令牌仍在作用域内生成。
- 风险与回滚:AuthPlugin 自己挂的路由行为不变,原有交接测试一行未改、全部通过。新增的只是一个导出;生成令牌用的内部函数(`runOneTimeTokenHandoff`、`withHandoffChallenge`、`resolveHandoffSignInEntry`、令牌存储 hasher)仍不导出,有测试钉住。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/one-time-token-handoff.ts` 文件末尾的 `answerOneTimeTokenHandoff`;`auth-plugin.ts` 约 4713 行起的路由(现在只调用它);`index.ts` 新增的导出块。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/one-time-token-handoff.test.ts -t "forwards the auth routes"`,预期 4 个用例通过:匿名探测 401、未登录页面导航 302 到宿主自己的登录页、登录后 302 到 App 且令牌凭 verifier 只能兑换一次、包根不导出内部函数。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`one-time-token-handoff.ts`** gains `answerOneTimeTokenHandoff(manager, request, serving)` with its two input types, in the shape the card spells (the shape cloud#3549 measured): `OneTimeTokenHandoffManager` (`getRegisteredAppSchemes`, `getApi`, `getConsoleUrl`, `getAuthIssuer`) and `OneTimeTokenHandoffServing` (`authMountPath`, `server`, `serverEnv?`, `onUnserved`); `request` is `{ url, headers, queries }`. Its body is the route body that used to live in `auth-plugin.ts`: `runOneTimeTokenHandoff` with `registeredSchemes`, `sessionCreatedAt` and `generate` read off `manager`, and `signInEntry` from `resolveHandoffSignInEntry` with `serving`. The module docblock gains a short section, "One implementation, two mounts", saying why only the whole answer is published.
- **`auth-plugin.ts`**: the `GET ${basePath}/one-time-token/handoff` mount calls `answerOneTimeTokenHandoff(this.authManager, { url, headers, queries }, { authMountPath: basePath, server: rawApp, serverEnv: c.env, onUnserved })`. The once-only `warn`, the `302`/JSON translation and the `500` catch are unchanged.
- **`index.ts`** (package root) exports `answerOneTimeTokenHandoff`, `type OneTimeTokenHandoffManager`, `type OneTimeTokenHandoffServing` and `type HandoffAnswer`, by name. `runOneTimeTokenHandoff`, `withHandoffChallenge`, `resolveHandoffSignInEntry` and `oneTimeTokenStoreHasher` stay unexported (order ruling).
- **`auth-route-ledger.ts`**: the `GET /api/v1/auth/one-time-token/handoff` row's note says a host that forwards the auth routes to an `AuthManager` it did not mount answers this route through `answerOneTimeTokenHandoff`, which is this mount's whole body.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/31420-one-time-token-handoff-export.md`: `@objectstack/plugin-auth` patch, `Clause-②: yes (widening)` (the seat's correction of the card's `no`: a new runtime export and three exported types on a published entry), `Metadata-protocol: none`.

## Tests

One new top-level `describe` in the existing harness file `one-time-token-handoff.test.ts`, "a host that forwards the auth routes answers it through the package export". The host is a Hono app that is not AuthPlugin's: no AuthPlugin is constructed, it serves its own `/_console/*` page, answers the hand-off with `answerOneTimeTokenHandoff` (imported from the package root, `./index`) for a real `AuthManager` it was handed, and forwards every other `/api/v1/auth/*` path to `manager.handleRequest`. Every request goes to the host at `https://env-42.hosted.example`, an origin other than the manager's `baseUrl`.

1. Anonymous JSON probe: `401`, `error.code` `UNAUTHENTICATED`, no `Location`, nothing minted.
2. Signed-out page navigation: `302`, `Cache-Control: no-store`, a root-relative `Location` to the host's own `/_console/login` with `redirect` naming the same request; `onUnserved` never called.
3. Signed-in navigation: `302` to `com.example.mobile://…?token=T`; `T.verifier` redeems at the host's `/one-time-token/verify` with `200`, the user and the session cookie; the replay answers `400 Invalid token`. Nothing written to `process.stdout`, `process.stderr`, `console.log/info/debug/warn/error` or the host's `onUnserved` carries `T`.
4. The package root exports `answerOneTimeTokenHandoff` and none of `runOneTimeTokenHandoff`, `withHandoffChallenge`, `resolveHandoffSignInEntry`, `oneTimeTokenStoreHasher`.

Every existing case in the file is unchanged (the file's import block gains the root import).

<details><summary>Red first, at base 3d73c1d6</summary>

New tests on the unchanged sources: 4 failed, 88 passed. Cases 1 to 3 answer `500` (the host's handler throws: the export does not exist), case 4 `expected 'undefined' to be 'function'`.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, committed head 241314c6, each restored with blob == HEAD and an empty git diff HEAD)</summary>

The test imports sources (`./index`), so no `dist/` is on the resolution path.

- **Mint outside the challenge scope.** In `runOneTimeTokenHandoff`, `await withHandoffChallenge(challenge.value, () => deps.generate(request.headers))` replaced by `await deps.generate(request.headers)` (anchor 1 → 0). Case 3 goes red on the redeem row: `{"message":"Invalid token"}: expected 400 to be 200`; cases 1, 2, 4 stay green. Restored.
- **Publish a minting seam.** In `index.ts`, `answerOneTimeTokenHandoff,` replaced by `answerOneTimeTokenHandoff as answerOneTimeTokenHandoff, runOneTimeTokenHandoff,`. Case 4 goes red: `runOneTimeTokenHandoff: expected [ 'DEFAULT_AUTH_BASE_PATH', …(164) ] to not include 'runOneTimeTokenHandoff'`. Restored.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Shape kept as the card spells it.** No deviation: the names and members are the card's. `AuthManager` satisfies `OneTimeTokenHandoffManager` structurally (its `getApi()` returns `Promise<Auth['api']>`, assignable to `Promise<unknown>`), checked by the package's `tsc --noEmit` through the AuthPlugin call site and by the test's annotated `const handedManager: OneTimeTokenHandoffManager = manager`.
- **`index.d.ts`.** After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth build`, `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.mts` each carry `answerOneTimeTokenHandoff` and the three types; `require('./dist/index.js')` answers `typeof answerOneTimeTokenHandoff === 'function'` and `false` for each of the four seams.
- **Serial constraint.** #30959 and #30967 also edit `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/**`. Whichever lands later merges `origin/main` once and re-runs the plugin-auth suite.
- **Governed surface.** `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD`, exit 0: "0 of 6 path(s) hit the register … NOT governed".

## Verification

All readings are on head `61481ad4` (the branch's fix commit `241314c6` plus one merge of `origin/main` at `4941c40b`, which brought nine commits including #31419's plugin-auth sign-in lockout work), after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and a rebuild of `@objectstack/plugin-auth...` through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (VERDICT command-exit 0). Each exit code is captured before any pipe.

- **plugin-auth suite**: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test`, VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 240 passed (240), Tests 4271 passed, 10 skipped.
- **plugin-auth typecheck**: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`, the examples project, and `check:test-typecheck`), VERDICT command-exit 0; the test layer holds at its recorded debt (10 files, 88 errors, 23 pinned signatures, none new).
- **Lint**: `eslint packages/plugins/plugin-auth --no-inline-config`, exit 0.
- **Derived gate union**: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 75 families for this diff; all 75 ran and exited 0. `--ran`: "75 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 75 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". Among them `check:auth-mount-ledger`, `check:route-envelope`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (122 require entry points across 72 packages load), `check:test-source-alias` and `check:type-check-debt`.

Same suite, typecheck and lint, all exit 0 (Tests 4252 passed, 10 skipped). The union: 74 of 75 exit 0. `check:plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first answered exit 3 on the shallow clone and exit 0 after `git fetch --depth=1` of its fixture commit; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` answered exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (not every package built). Both are exit 0 on the final head above.
</details>

The `test:repo` project, `Test Core` shards and the dogfood battery are CI's; this PR's check-runs carry them. The title has no `!` and `Clause-②` has no `(narrowing)` arm, so no local dogfood run is owed.
